subject: chemistry
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: A pure substance, unlike a mixture, will:
options: Melt and boil at specific sharp temperatures
Melt over a range of temperatures
questions.explain: A pure substance has a sharp, specific melting and boiling point, whereas mixtures melt and boil over a range.

questions.q: Which property is typical of transition metals but not Group 1 metals?
options: They are solids at room temperature
questions.explain: Transition metals commonly form coloured compounds and act as catalysts.

questions.q: Mendeleev left gaps in his periodic table because he:
options: Could not order the known elements
Wanted to separate metals from non-metals
Predicted elements that were not yet discovered
questions.explain: Mendeleev left gaps for undiscovered elements and predicted their properties.

questions.q: Where are non-metals generally found in the periodic table?
questions.explain: Non-metals are located on the right-hand side of the periodic table.

questions.q: In the reactivity series, which of these metals is the most reactive?
questions.explain: Potassium is near the top of the reactivity series, far above iron, zinc and copper.

questions.q: Which of these metals is the least reactive?
questions.explain: Gold is at the bottom of the reactivity series, making it the least reactive listed.

questions.q: What is observed when a small piece of sodium is added to water?
options: It fizzes, moves on the surface and releases hydrogen
It turns the water bright blue
questions.explain: Sodium reacts vigorously with water, fizzing as it produces hydrogen gas and sodium hydroxide.

questions.q: In the reaction CuO + H2 -> Cu + H2O, what happens to the copper oxide?
questions.explain: The copper oxide loses oxygen, so it is reduced.

questions.q: What is produced when a Group 1 metal reacts with water?
questions.explain: Group 1 metals react with water to form a metal hydroxide and hydrogen gas.

questions.q: In a sacrificial protection system, the metal attached to iron must be:
questions.explain: A more reactive metal corrodes in preference to the iron, protecting it sacrificially.

questions.q: A white precipitate forms when barium chloride is added to a solution containing:
questions.explain: Sulfate ions form a white precipitate of barium sulfate with barium chloride.

questions.q: At room temperature, chlorine is a:
questions.explain: Chlorine is a green (yellow-green) gas at room temperature.
